finding: The newly added exact-source FREE_SWARM_ADMISSION_BOUNDARY_RECEIPT/v1 runner on main executed only tests.test_free_swarm_admission_boundary_867. Supervisor 8.68 and the current all-worker directive require missing/malformed admission, UNKNOWN, PAID, SUBSCRIPTION, authority mismatch and unlisted-provider cases to prove zero secret lookup and zero network attempts. The dedicated 8.68 malformed-admission regression existed on main but was not included in the runner test module, source manifest, or boundary-pass coverage condition. A green receipt could therefore omit a mandatory 8.68 discriminator.
hypothesis: Binding both canonical admission-boundary modules and requiring named mandatory blocked-case tests to be observed in verbose unittest output prevents the receipt from passing if required 8.68 coverage is accidentally omitted while preserving source-hash and network-tripwire evidence.
counterhypothesis: The separate malformed regression is sufficient because it exists in the repository and may be run independently.
